title: An old COD customer moved to Credit Hold gets $0, its limit kept in the note
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Have customer A, from before the release, on COD with a credit limit of $1,000.00 still stored.
  • Note your user name.
  • Make sure COD is the shop's default for new customers.
  • Start on the Credit Terms page (Settings, then "Credit Terms" in the Finance group), Active tab.
custom_steps:
1. Click the "⋯" at the right of the "COD" row.
  2. Click "Move Customers".
  3. Click "Select None".
  4. Type customer A's name in "Search customers".
  5. Tick customer A.
  6. Choose "Credit Hold" in "Move To".
  7. Click "Move 1 Customer".
  8. Click "Set Limits To $0 And Move".
  9. Open customer A's customer page.
  10. Click the "Notes" tab.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The menu opens.

Step 2:

  • The "Move Customers from COD" window opens with every COD customer ticked.

Step 3:

  • The count reads "0 selected".

Step 4:

  • Only customer A is listed.

Step 5:

  • The count reads "1 selected".

Step 6:

  • The line "Their credit limit will be set to $0." shows.

Step 7:

  • The confirmation "Set 1 customer's credit limit to $0?" opens.

Step 8:

  • The toast "1 customer moved to Credit Hold." shows.

Step 9:

  • The "Credit term" reads Credit Hold and the credit limit reads $0.00.

Step 10:

  • The note reads "Credit term changed from COD to Credit Hold by your user name (Move Customers). Credit limit $1,000.00 → $0."

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Credit terms", Confluence 963346440, version 3 (22 Oct 2026, "Renamed to Credit terms", Chris Ward), read 23 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11638, story SV-11673 (Story 4, Move Customers), story SV-11680 (Story 11, Release day: what changes for existing users)

  • S11-R17: “If such a customer is moved to COD or Credit Hold with Move Customers, its limit becomes $0 at that moment, after the S4-R14 confirmation, and its previous limit is kept in its note (S4-R20).”
  • S4-R20: “When a move changes a customer's limit (a limit above $0 set to $0), that customer's note (S4-R11) ends with "Credit limit {old limit} → $0." A customer whose limit was already $0 or blank gets the S4-R11 note without it.”
  • S4-R14: “When "Move To" is COD or Credit Hold, pressing "Move {n} Customers" first opens a confirmation titled "Set {n} customers' credit limit to $0?" ("Set 1 customer's credit limit to $0?" for one), with the message "This can't be undone. Their current limits are kept in each customer's note, and the Credit Terms Log records the move." and the buttons "Cancel" and a red "Set Limits to $0 and Move" (displayed as "Set Limits To $0 And Move").”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.
